name: duo-budget
description: Duo Budget planning app. Android and the Capacitor iOS shell live beside the existing widget project in ios/.

scripts.cap:sync: node ios/sync-www.js && npx cap sync && node tools/check-ios-ready.js
scripts.ios:prepare: node ios/sync-www.js && npx cap sync ios && node tools/check-ios-ready.js
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:auth: node backend/test/test-account.js && node backend/test/test-lock.js && node backend/test/test-premium.js
scripts.test:sql: node backend/test/test-rls.js && DUO_STUB_EXPOSED=1 node backend/test/test-rls.js && node backend/test/test-delete-account.js && node backend/test/test-premium-sql.js
scripts.test:spend: node tools/build-personal.js && node tools/build-demo-data.js && node tools/privacy-check.js && node test-spending.js
scripts.test: npm run test:bucket && npm run test:copy && npm run test:sync && npm run test:auth && npm run test:sql && npm run test:spend
